{{Quote|I've recoded a child’s noisemaker. Tack it to the inside of the Embass suit and it'll make Turman sound like he has two heartbeats. You want three? I can give him three heartbeats.|Thaymes Fodrick|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
A '''noisemaker''' was a type of device used to produce sound. [[Thaymes Fodrick]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], recoded a child's noisemaker to simulate multiple heartbeats and installed it to the [[Embass suit]] created by their [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Viull Gorsat]]. The suit was worn by their [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Turman Durra]] while disguised as the unidentified species "Embassy-Who-Climbs".<ref name="MK" />
